# Dealer Agent Protocol
> Open MCP standard for car dealership inventory, availability, and pricing disclosure, so AI agents answer shoppers with the dealer's real price, real fees, and current availability. Apache-2.0. Reference gateway and synthetic test data available.

# DealershipMCP
> Dealer Growth Hackers' commercial dealer-answer platform. It combines Dealer AI Visibility, on-site conversational inventory search, and a managed Dealer Agent Gateway built on the open Dealer Agent Protocol.

## Product system
- Dealer AI Visibility measures whether AI systems can find and accurately represent a dealership and its competitive position.
- Dealer AEO Audit diagnoses website, entity, content, and citation gaps that influence AI answers.
- On-Site AI Search is a pilot module that translates natural-language shopper intent into dealer-approved inventory matches and dealer query receipts.
- Dealer Agent Gateway is the operated dealer-specific MCP service for external AI agents.
- Dealer Agent Protocol is the portable Apache-2.0 contract underneath the Gateway.

DealershipMCP can publish provider-neutral used-vehicle facts including mileage, dated inventory age, authorized history-report summaries, title, inspection, certification, warranty, public reconditioning facts, and unresolved source conflicts. CARFAX, AutoCheck, or other provider support depends on dealer authorization and contract rights and does not imply a partnership.

## Important distinctions
- Dealer Agent Protocol is the independently implementable open standard.
- A Dealer Agent Gateway is software that implements the standard.
- DealershipMCP is one commercial gateway product.
- Dealer Agent Protocol is not Auto Agent Protocol; a compatibility bridge is documented.
- Planned integrations are roadmap items, not partnership or availability claims.
